NBA-MIA-at-GS-1106.summary: Miami comes in on the second night of a back-to-back after playing the Clippers in Inglewood on Nov. 4. Giannis Antetokounmpo was listed probable with a wrist issue for that game, and no other Heat regulars were on the report. For Golden State, no new injury or rotation news turned up beyond what the app already has (Santos, Porzingis, Butler and Moody out). Giannis played 40 minutes on Nov 4 but tweaked the sprained right wrist and it was heavily wrapped afterward; his status for tonight is unresolved.

NBA-ORL-at-PHX-1106.summary: Phoenix plays the second half of a home back-to-back; Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle) are listed out (estimated return Nov 5, so an upgrade is possible), and Mark Williams remains out after shoulder surgery. Orlando is without Banchero, Suggs, Isaac, Penda and Izaiyah Nelson, matching what the app already shows; no new starter or rotation changes found.

SOCCER-day.summary: Milan without suspended keeper Maignan and several defenders/attackers; Benfica expected to rotate; Brann lose their keeper and a forward; Sunderland miss two suspended centre-backs. Bobby Thomas a calf doubt, Harder fit and scoring.

fix.summary: Availability check on the NBA Top 10 picks (list paused until Nov 15).

NBA-ATL-at-WSH-1105.summary: Atlanta's Jalen Johnson (left ankle sprain, missed Monday) and Washington's Alex Sarr (knee, missed Monday) are both questionable; Landale and Gueye are out for Atlanta, leaving Okongwu with Newell and Ejiofor behind him. Lu Dort started for Johnson on Monday. It is Trae Young's first game against his former team.

NBA-CHA-at-BKN-1105.summary: Kon Knueppel (hamstring) is probable and expected to make his season debut, likely moving Sion James back to the bench; he may need a few games to ramp up. Coby White (calf) is probable; Grant Williams remains out. Brooklyn's report is limited to Tyler Bilodeau and Egor Demin.

NBA-CHI-at-NY-1105.summary: Josh Hart is questionable with right ankle soreness; if he sits, the Knicks lean on a bench that just produced 22 points from Landry Shamet. Chicago (1-6, worst defense in points allowed) lists Nic Claxton (hamstring) as questionable and Jalen Smith (finger) probable, with Smith starting at center while Claxton is out.

NBA-DAL-at-SA-1105.summary: Dallas is without Max Christie (hip), Dereck Lively II (foot) and several reserves, and Santi Aldama is questionable (knee), so Zaccharie Risacher moves into the starting lineup. Cooper Flagg sprained his left shoulder on Oct. 23 and missed the Oct. 24 game against the Spurs; he is now off the injury list. San Antonio is missing Tobias Harris (calf).

NBA-MIL-at-BOS-1105.summary: Jayson Tatum is questionable for a possible rest night and Payton Pritchard is questionable with a shoulder contusion; Devin Carter is out with mono. Paul George is off the report after resting against Houston. Milwaukee (1-6) lists no injuries.

NBA-PHI-at-DET-1105.summary: Detroit is without Jalen Duren (hamstring, re-evaluation in two weeks) and Isaiah Joe (hip, left Sunday's game early and ruled out), so Paul Reed starts at center and bench guard and wing minutes open up. Philadelphia is missing reserve bigs Ariel Hukporti (season-ending Achilles) and Dominick Barlow (back); its starting five is intact.

NBA-POR-at-PHX-1105.summary: Portland is without Ja Morant (Grade 2 hamstring strain, about four weeks), leaving Jrue Holiday as the lead bench guard behind Lillard and Henderson; he posted 17/8/10 with three made threes at Denver. Phoenix ranks last in defensive efficiency, and Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle) are questionable.

NBA-UTAH-at-NO-1105.summary: Jaxson Hayes is healthy and starting at center; his shoulder absence was last week (Oct 26). Utah's frontcourt is thin, with Nurkic (foot) and Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL, 6-8 weeks) out and Bamba questionable (ankle). For New Orleans, Missi (knee) is out so Matkovic starts, while Murphy (knee) and Poole (ankle) are probable.

NFL-JAX-at-BAL-1106.summary: Baltimore starts undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano, who is playing on a taped ankle, with Lamar Jackson headed to IR and Tyler Huntley hurt; Jacksonville is a 10-point road favorite. Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten (foot/ankle) has missed both practices, backup Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) and WR Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) are limited, and Baltimore will use Jake Moody at kicker with Tyler Loop headed to IR. No candidate is on an app TD list (on_app_td_list null for all).
